incident.symptom: filelock import crashes inside Pyodide because Gradio Lite replaces os.link with a two-argument lambda and filelock probes follow_symlinks=False
incident.trace_signature: TypeError: <lambda>() got an unexpected keyword argument 'follow_symlinks'

root_cause.result: signature mismatch during filelock import before app.py executes

prior_recovery.limitation: The upstream one-off patch resolves huggingface-hub dependency installation but does not fix the newer filelock/os.link WASM incompatibility.

remediation.worker_patch: os.link accepts arbitrary args/kwargs and raises NotImplementedError so filelock detects hard links as unsupported

human_authorization.basis: Continuation of the already-authorized GALIA dashboard deployment and runtime remediation.
